summary: End-to-end testing of Elegant Home Advisors — Backend (33 pytest cases, all passing) and Frontend (public site + admin dashboard). All critical flows work: health, properties CRUD + all filters, meta, settings, testimonials, faqs, inquiry validation, auth (login/me/protected), CSV export, homepage sections, hero search, category/location cards, property detail (gallery, buttons, inquiry form with validation + toast), floating WhatsApp + QR modal, cookie banner persistence, admin login/logout, admin nav (Overview KPIs 8/3/3/5, Properties, Inquiries with 3 rows + Export CSV button, Testimonials, FAQs, Settings). No blocking issues.

issues: 'Share on WhatsApp' button uses https://api.whatsapp.com/send URL (works, but review request expected wa.me). Both are valid WhatsApp share URLs so this is only a naming nit.

action_items: Optional: In /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Testimonials.jsx line 45, the rating <option> children are wrapped by dev-mode instrumentation (span in option) triggering a React hydration warning in the console. Not a functional bug and only appears in dev mode, but if you want a clean console you could refactor the option label to a value-only pattern.
Optional: Overview KPI cards use Promise.all with default 0 fallback — no loading skeleton, so first paint briefly shows 0/0/0/0 before hydration. Cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~757 lines) is close to the 700-line soft limit — consider splitting seed data and models into separate modules if the codebase keeps growing.
GET /api/settings uses upsert-on-first-call on a public endpoint (no auth). Fine here (single 'global' doc, seed also runs at startup) but worth noting as a design choice.

In list_properties() line 293, `query.setdefault('price_min', {})['$lte'] = max_price` mutates a possibly-existing $gte dict — this is correct only because min_price/max_price both feed into price_min. If price_min is not a dict (never true here), this would fail; document behavior or use a small helper.
Header rating <option>{n} Stars</option> in Testimonials.jsx is fine in prod build but yields a hydration warning in dev instrumentation.
PropertyDetail.jsx wa-share button uses api.whatsapp.com/send whereas the WhatsApp button and floating buttons use wa.me. Consider unifying.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly. All data-testids in kebab-case and applied to interactive elements. Auth stored in localStorage under 'eha_token' (matches spec).
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via {'_id': 0} projection and strip_id() helper — no ObjectId leakage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical UI flows verified: homepage, search, filters, detail, inquiry form, WA QR modal, cookie banner, admin login/CRUD/logout)

seed_data_creation: None — backend startup seeds 8 properties, 3 testimonials, 5 FAQs, admin user, global settings. Test inquiries prefixed TEST_ were cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` from /app. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Test data uses TEST_ prefix and self-cleans. Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. All 33 backend tests pass and all major frontend flows verified. Note: Promise.all in Overview.jsx needs ~2-3s wait before KPI cards populate; use `await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)` after login to check counts.
